dialogues.speaker: Someone's Notes
dialogues.text: (Many sundry accounts are written here. They seem to be passage fees collected from travelers.)

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Notes
dialogues.text: "...Those two old fogeys at Wangshan Hall are still hoodwinking tourists. Perhaps we should expand our business, maybe get a cut of their take as protection fees..."

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Notes
dialogues.text: "...Which should also help cover up our larger business of digging up and smuggling antiques just nicely."
